categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of high-end special steel materials and precision mechanical parts for high-end equipment. Key product lines include gear steel, mold steel, special alloys, and special stainless steel materials, as well as wind power castings, wind power main shafts, precision mechanical parts for wind power gearboxes, cast steel parts, and other mechanical components. These products serve industries such as new energy wind power, energy equipment, rail transit, mechanical equipment, military, aerospace, nuclear power, and marine petrochemical sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced smelting, forming, heat treatment, and precision machining technologies, including vacuum melting, electroslag remelting, and 3D printing for special structures. It has developed proprietary processes for high-purity alloy production, high-performance gear steel, wind power main shaft manufacturing, and large-scale casting and forging. The firm emphasizes technology innovation with over 214 patents, including 107 invention patents, and focuses on process optimization, defect control, and digital twin technology for manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic and international manufacturers in new energy wind power, rail transit, mechanical equipment, military, aerospace, nuclear power, and marine petrochemical industries. The company has established relationships with major clients such as Siemens, ZF, China CRRC, and various state-owned enterprises. The new energy wind power sector accounts for approximately 55.8% of the company's main business revenue.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with major production bases in Zhangjiagang (Jiangsu Province), Rugao (Jiangsu Province), and Deyang (Sichuan Province). It also has an expanding international presence, with exports to Europe and other regions, and has registered trademarks in Europe to enhance brand influence.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across the upstream to downstream spectrum of the special steel and precision parts supply chain. It controls core processes including smelting, forming, heat treatment, and precision machining, enabling full-process integration and supply chain control. It positions itself as a leading supplier of both raw special steel materials and finished precision components, particularly for wind power gearboxes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening the high-end equipment special steel and precision parts business, expanding production capacity for wind power gearbox components, and advancing technology innovation in special alloys and new energy wind power materials. The company invests heavily in R&D, focusing on process innovation, product quality improvement, and new product development such as large-scale wind power castings and nuclear fusion materials. It also emphasizes intellectual property protection and digital manufacturing technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of special steel materials and precision mechanical parts to end customers, including large equipment manufacturers. The company follows an order-driven production model with direct sales domestically and internationally, without intermediaries. Revenue recognition is based on product delivery and customer acceptance, with payment terms typically 30 to 90 days post-delivery.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the special steel materials sector, the company competes with major state-owned groups like CITIC Special Steel, Dongbei Special Steel, and Baosteel Special Steel, as well as specialized private enterprises. It holds a competitive position in niche, high-technical-demand segments such as wind power materials. In wind power castings, it is among the top domestic producers with advantages in technology and scale, competing with firms like Riyue and Jixin Technology. The company aims to strengthen its leadership in precision gearbox components through capacity expansion and technology upgrades.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 4.0 billion, a 5.67% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 114.64 million, up 4.97%. Total assets reached RMB 11.46 billion, growing 7.54% from the previous year. The company maintains steady growth with improving profitability and has invested significantly in expanding production capacity and R&D, including an additional RMB 820 million self-funded investment in core precision parts projects.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its strong technological innovation capabilities, full-process industrial chain integration, and high product quality and stability. It offers customized, high-performance special steel materials and precision parts that meet stringent requirements for high-end equipment in harsh environments. Its ability to control the entire production process from smelting to precision machining allows for cost control, quality assurance, and rapid response to customer needs, providing a one-stop solution that reduces downstream manufacturing costs and enhances customer efficiency.
